_note: 酒類（日本酒以外）の系譜。品目ハブ（/en/eat/drinks/）の横並び表と、各系譜ページがここから描く。出典は docs/research/drinks-2026-10-11.md と各系譜ページの sources。日本酒は sake.json、居酒屋・角打ちは izakaya.json で扱うのでここには行を作らない。whisky は素材（表示基準・山崎）があるが記事は beer-highball に含めたため planned。planned の行の era は「—」のまま（記憶の年号を出さない）。価格は税込の公式表示が確認できず、どの行にも載せていない

axes.label: What the law or label says

origin.place: Okinawa, southern Kyushu, Iki, Kuma, Amami, the Izu Islands
origin.era: distilling in Okinawa from the 15th century (two accounts)

cells.made: Kōji and yeast in one vessel; continuous still, or a single still often used once
cells.law: Continuous-still under 36%, single-still 45% or less; only some single-still may say honkaku
cells.served: With water, hot water (6:4 suggested), on the rocks, with soda; maewari rested in advance
cells.marker: GIs for Iki, Kuma, Ryūkyū, Satsuma and Tokyo Shimazake; brown-sugar shōchū only in Amami

origin.place: Yokohama, Sapporo, Osaka; the highball revival by Suntory
origin.era: from 1870 (each brewer’s own account); highball revival 2008

cells.made: Beer from malt, hops and water; happoshu with malt or barley as part; highball is whisky with soda
cells.law: Beer, happoshu and new genre taxed at one rate from October 2026; craft beer has no legal definition
cells.served: Suntory’s highball rule: mug full of ice, chilled soda poured gently, whisky 1 to soda 4
cells.marker: 430 local-beer sites at March 2025 after the 1994 licence change; highball spread through izakaya

lineages.name: Japanese whisky
lineages.nameJa: ジャパニーズウイスキー

cells.made: Malt, grains and Japanese water; distilled in Japan; three years or more in wood in Japan
cells.law: A makers’ association standard from 2021, not a law; no GI on the tax agency’s list
cells.marker: A logo for the standard from March 2025
